Stockfish.js 19, lite single-threaded build: the chess engine Gambit plays.

Package:  stockfish@19.0.1 on npm (https://www.npmjs.com/package/stockfish), by Nathan Rugg for Chess.com
Files:    bin/stockfish-19-lite-single.js and bin/stockfish-19-lite-single.wasm, shipped here unchanged
          (SHA-256 ccb130d7ff29408531c47d859a49f91d59d4f482d05a53eb1a3231a4f624c91a and
           ee4f115bdb2d32cadf96cada104a05b5ec257d7ad6f57582190b49bc71f096de)
Source:   https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js (v19.0.1), built from Stockfish 19,
          https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish, by the Stockfish developers
Network:  the lite build's small NNUE net, nn-61e7af4bb97d, by Chris Bao (sscg13)
Licence:  GNU General Public License, version 3 (Copying.txt)

Why this build: the single-threaded engine needs no SharedArrayBuffer, so it runs on a static host such as GitHub
Pages, which can't send the cross-origin isolation headers the threaded builds need; the lite net keeps it under 2 MB.
Gambit runs it in a Web Worker (uci.js) and speaks UCI to it; it loads only when a game against it starts, and is kept
offline with the rest of the app.
